verdict.rationale: Windmill describes itself as an open-source, self-hostable workflow engine in its llms.txt and docs, and its source is published in a public GitHub repository (windmill-labs/windmill). A community comment also praises it as open rather than locked down. Missing for 10: the specific license name and terms are not evidenced, there is no evidence about which parts (if any) are under non-open or enterprise licensing, and there is no independent confirmation of license openness.
